settings.about_text:
Chem-Inter was founded by selling semiconductors and other chemicals and mechanical parts. In 2021, they will celebrate the 40th anniversary of their founding by merging with Comstar Japan, which sold environmentally friendly bio-cleaning agents, and expanding their business.

Going forward, Chem-Inter will continue to propose and sell products that meet the needs of their customers, expand them globally, and develop their business.
